notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
⯈ Changes:
• New capsule artwork (Steam Page)
• New menu logo art
• New font, now supports letters with accents
• New mechanic (in the last level)
• Player cannot move during transitions
• Minor bug fixes

⯈ Last Level:
The last level [=] has been redesigned with a new mechanic. This mechanic introduces clocks to collect, which extend the timer's duration before dying.

⯈ Appreciation:
I'd like to express my gratitude to everyone who has supported my game by purchasing it; it's been almost 2 years since "10 Seconds to Win" was released. I promise there will be more game related news in the future.

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
⯈ Changes:
• Improved "Dash" Tutorial Board
• New Menu Buttons Design
• Minor Bug Fixes

⯈ Fifth Level:
 The tutorial board was causing a lot of confusion because it wasn't explicit which key to press.
 I redid the button design and hope that there are no more questions. I hope you can understand that "Shift" does the Dash.
 Thanks for all the people who did the review talking about it.

⚠️ Attention! ⚠️
 After this update the old saves will no longer be compatible with the game, it will be necessary to play again to unlock the levels.
 I apologize, I tried everything to avoid this, but as the project was old I had to create a new save system to be compatible with Steam.
